title: Treacherous Estate
author: Behcet Kaya
description:
"Treacherous Estate" is the introductory novel in the Jack Ludefance PI series, a gripping, fast-paced thriller that mixes modern crime drama with a classic Noir atmosphere. The story, written in the first-person perspective, follows the investigations of Jacques (Jack to his friends and family) Ludefance, an unconventional and sharp-witted private investigator working in the Florida Panhandle. Jack is portrayed as an old-school, ‘think outside the box’ investigator who is not afraid to break rules to achieve justice. He lives aboard his 57-foot Hatteras, named The LUNA SEA, complete with a pet alligator, and faces personal challenges, including his father’s Alzheimer’s.
